scenarios.description: Representative inputs from the reviewed test fixture.

inputs.feature_idea: Let agency admins approve expenses in bulk from the weekly digest email.

replies.problem: Admins approve expenses one at a time.

user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to select many expenses so that I can approve them at once.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting 20 expenses and approving marks all 20 approved

user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to approve from the digest email so that I skip logging in.
acceptance_criteria: The digest has an Approve all link

requirements.requirement: Signed approval link in the digest

open_questions: Is there an approval limit per batch?

rubric.question: Is everything stated consistent with the inputs (and sources, where used), with nothing invented?
Would the intended user act on this output with little or no editing?
Does it cover everything the task asks for, without padding?
Every requirement serves a declared story, and every story has a requirement.
Acceptance criteria are specific and testable.

expectedFailureBehavior: A model failure ends the run as failed with the reason; nothing is invented.
Invalid replies are retried within the call budget, then kept as needs review.
knownGaps: Live output quality is unknown until a live run is reviewed.
